$Comment: Christmas Eve, the end of Santa's story each year: once Elsie's Wrapping Presents is done, bring Santa
Gingerbread Cookies for the sack and carrots for the reindeer, and give him a present for the sleigh.
The _Christmas folder makes the id christmas_eve. The cookies and carrots are TURN_IN steps handed in
at Santa; the present is a USE_ITEM step qualified by Santa's id (Christmas_Santa): holding a Christmas
Present and pointing it at him spends it and counts here
(Item/Interactions/Christmas/Christmas_Present_Give.json). All three steps share Order 1, so they can
be done in any order, and the TURN_IN steps are handed in at Santa, so no report-back step is added.
Its pay holds that year's keepsake, the Christmas Ornament (Item/Items/Christmas/Christmas_Ornament.json)
with the year on it, collected with the rest at Santa. The first Claim row is the ornament: StackNameArg
@run reads as the label of the Christmas run this quest is paid for, which for a yearly event is the
year it started, and StackNameKey, keepsake.christmas_ornament.name, is stamped into every ornament
handed over and read back from the item, so never rename that key. Finishing it also earns that year's
keepsake achievement, christmas_ornament, for its points. Collecting it rolls Christmas_Eve_Pay, whose
first roll cues the celebration moment Christmas_Eve_Delivered.
Repeat.PerRun brings this one quest back once in each year's run of Christmas: a run pays it once, a
forced or moved run cannot pay it twice, and an Eve left unfinished when the run ends waits for next
year and counts for that year's run. The steps before it never come back. After it, Santa's lines say
the story is done until next year and send the player to the dailies, the thieves and the stalls.
The Mmo_Xp row is MMO Skill Tree's: Crafting XP, the capstone's share, for the baking and the
wrapping, waiting to be collected with the rest. The row's own Requires, the hytale:mod_installed gate,
leaves it out on a server without that mod, unpaid and unshown, and the rest of the quest pays.
Name: Eve
